mechanism: Detect swing highs/lows via left/right bar dominance; treat swings as graph nodes; edge weight = abs(price_u−price_v); run Dijkstra from first swing; last node vs previous on shortest-path tree yields buy if entry>reference else sell. FilterAndMarkValidSwings invalidates swings later breached. SL/TP from swing-to-swing distance (+PointBuffer).
data_needed: OHLC swing window (LeftBars/RightBars); MaxSwings; current symbol bars on chosen TF.
why_new_for_mis: Frames market structure as a weighted swing graph and exposes shortest-path direction as a regime/change sensor—MIS can use path cost and last-edge sign as structural features.

mechanism: vector.SingularSpectrumAnalysisSpectrum(WindowLen) → relative eigenvalue contributions (sum to 1); CumSum → cumulative; elbow on relative-contribution plot separates dominant signal components from slowly decaying noise floor; paired similar contributions often mark a single periodic mode.
data_needed: Univariate series (e.g. close); window length L (rule of thumb 2..N/2); optional linear-regression detrend before SSA.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: SSA_PriceDecomposition EA on arbitrary symbol/date/length (screenshot EURUSD closes); scripts for any series
why_new_for_mis: Supplies MIS a non-parametric spectral regime sensor: count/share of dominant SSA components and elbow index as signal-vs-noise regime tags.
quote: The point that separates the dominant components from the rest is usually referred to as the "elbow point," and the components below this level are called the "noise floor."

mechanism: SingularSpectrumAnalysisReconstructSeries(WindowLen, FilterComponents) sums top-k reconstructed components into a denoised series; SingularSpectrumAnalysisForecast uses Linear Recurrent Relation coefficients from reconstructed signal to iteratively predict ForecastLen steps. Weighted component correlation matrix groups near-orthogonal vs paired oscillatory modes.
data_needed: Same series + chosen FilterComponents (from elbow or 85–95% cumulative variance); ForecastLen; optional component_corr(windowlen, components).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo deterministic series + EURUSD price decomposition GUI; any TF sample length N
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS SSA-based filtered trend/cycle sensors and an LRR multi-step forecast path—structure/noise separation beyond classical indicators.
quote: To forecast a new data point, the algorithm applies a linear combination of the previous 'window length' values of the reconstructed series, weighted by the determined coefficients.

mechanism: After high-impact window [evt−BeforeMin, evt+AfterMin], iBarShift to M1 event bar; spike_pips=(close−open)/(point*10); if |spike|≥InpSpikeThresholdPipsPI, require InpConfirmBarsPI subsequent M1 bars all same direction; entry at next open with SL beyond prior bar extreme±buffer and TP=RR×risk. NFP replay uses first-Friday + US DST for 8:30 ET timestamp.
